name: Chocolate Fudge Brownies
recipeInstructions: Melt chocolate and butter together in pan over low heat, stir in sugar and eggs one at a time, beat well with wooden spoon, then stir in sifted flour and walnuts. Pour into greased 20cm square baking tin. Bake in moderate oven 30 minuts, cool in tin.
